``` {r}
# Task 1.1: Cleaning the Data
clean_up_wb_csv <- function(
    in_file_name,
    out_file_name) {
  
  # Read the CSV starting from row 5.
  wb_data <- read.csv(
    in_file_name,
    skip = 4,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  # Remove completely empty columns
  wb_data <- wb_data[, colSums(!is.na(wb_data) & wb_data != "") > 0]
  
  # Remove completely empty rows
  wb_data <- wb_data[rowSums(!is.na(wb_data) & wb_data != "") > 0, ]
  
  # Clean column names by removing extra spaces
  names(wb_data) <- trimws(names(wb_data))
  
  # Remove rows where Country Name is missing
  if ("Country Name" %in% names(wb_data)) {
    wb_data <- wb_data[wb_data$`Country Name` != "" & !is.na(wb_data$`Country Name`), ]
  }
  
  # Save the cleaned CSV
  write.csv(
    wb_data,
    out_file_name,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Task 1.2: Importing the Data as Data Frame
indicator <- clean_up_wb_csv("AdjustedNetNationalIncome/API_NY.ADJ.NNTY.KD_DS2_en_csv_v2_3377.csv", "indicator.csv")

population <- clean_up_wb_csv("world_bank_total_population/API_SP.POP.TOTL_DS2_en_csv_v2_267553.csv", "population.csv")
```
